messages:
julia_sales: Heads-up 10x Summit wants a 10-day POC starting next week. Ask: billing project, $3k hard cap, 10 days of promo credits, expiring scoped API keys, and a short-lived Dedicated pool (prefers eu-central-1). They may request VPC peering later. Can we do this low-friction?

noah_se: Yes. Typical plan: create billing org -> project -> apply spendshield -> grant promo credits -> issue ephemeral keys scoped to the project. Dedicated and VPC require infra ticket.

maya_finops: We can grant 10 days of credits up to $1,500 and attach a $3,000 hard spendshield. Promo credits are consumed first. Manager approval required for credits > $1,000; I can route. No automatic charging beyond the spendshield.

julia_sales: Sales will cover $1.5k promo credits. No PM provided for trial. I'll get legal name + billing contact.

diego_infra: For Dedicated burst we need expected RPS, model family (or token/sec), and region. If they only need it for 10 days we can propose a "temp-burst" instance if capacity allows. VPC peering needs a diagram + CIDR.

noah_se: They estimate 40 req/s, ~1.2k tokens/sec total, using open-medium models, prefer eu-central-1 but can fall back to eu-west-1.

tara_support: Ephemeral key example to share (10d TTL):
```
# create ephemeral key (10 days)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/ephemeral \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -d '{"project_id":"proj-summit-poc","ttl_seconds":864000,"scopes":["inference:generate"]}'
```
Note: ephemeral keys cannot change billing settings. Recommend rotating mid-POC.

ticket-bot: infra/3345 created: "Summit POC - temp dedicated (eu-central-1) + optional VPC" assigned to diego_infra. ETA: 48h for capacity check. finance/3346: "Summit promo credits $1500 + spendshield $3000" queued for approval.

julia_sales: Action items: Maya to route credit approval; Diego to confirm dedicated availability; Noah/Tara to prepare quickstart and ephemeral keys; I'll send billing contact and confirm kickoff. Thanks :raised_hands:
